record_scope_reconstruction: The residual Siret restriction applied to trucks entering Romania after outward traffic resumed on 17 January. RFE/RL still described Siret as partially/completely blocked on 19 January; the January 20 report confirms Siret reopened.

source_checks.finding: TVR distinguishes ten outward trucks per hour from complete blockage inbound to Romania.
RFE/RL January 19 confirms Siret remained blocked when Vicovu de Sus reopened.
January 20 account explicitly says Siret–Porubne was unblocked that day.

sites.evidence_note: Preserved OSM node 3019220234 v3 anchors the Romanian road-control end; the Council land-border evaluation identifies Siret opposite Porubne on E85. The independent published crossing coordinates at umanmap.eu are within about 70 m. Actual protest machinery stretched along the approach, not necessarily at this pin.
